en.title: HarborShield | Port delay, replenishment and working capital
en.headline: What does a port delay do to an order’s cash flow?
en.subtitle: Singapore 2024 · replenishment, working capital and trade-document integrity
en.intro: Start with a documented public event. Compare the trade-offs between cheaper transport, avoiding stockouts and financing a replenishment order. Change the assumptions below to recalculate locally in your browser.
en.boundary: The public event is real; orders, freight, premiums, rates, funding limits and service options are constructed. This is not a client transaction, company deployment, bank approval or record of achieved savings.
en.case_title: Screen for feasibility, then compare economic burden
en.order_note: Constructed order: 5,000 units bought at US$30 and sold at US$42. A 30% deposit is paid 7 days before departure; the balance and logistics are paid on departure. All other fixed inputs are in the result JSON.
en.constraint_note: These are assumed screening criteria, not approved credit or a promised delivery. Peak funding need already deducts own cash. Zero is a binding limit; a blank funding limit or deadline means that constraint is not applied. The contribution floor is required, with a minimum of zero.
en.snapshot: Default calculation snapshot. JavaScript is required to recalculate.
en.noscript: JavaScript is off. You can read the default results, but changing inputs will not update them.
en.economics_note: Stockout opportunity is foregone contribution on unmet pre-arrival demand, not a second cash payment. This simplified model assumes the replenishment order is eventually sold in full. No additional daily-delay charge is added. Net economic contribution is not audited accounting profit.
en.json_summary: View current JSON results (copy to save)
en.ledger_title: When does the funding gap begin?
en.scm_title: Faster is not always better value
en.scm_body: When inventory is sufficient, paying for speed may not be worthwhile. When stock is scarce, foregone contribution may outweigh freight savings. Try a funding limit of US$129,000 and a deadline of day 15: the cheapest eligible option changes. Then move the deadline to day 12: no option meets both limits.
en.scm_note: Actual service availability, priority capacity and alternate-port customs feasibility are unverified. The 27 sensitivity settings are deterministic comparisons, not predicted probabilities.
en.finance_title: Profit and liquidity are different questions
en.finance_body: An order with a positive planned margin can still need financing before collection. The event ledger makes that timing visible. Interest is calculated over the area of negative incremental balances. A low-cost option is not recommended if it breaches the funding or timing limit, or falls below the contribution floor.
en.finance_note: Interest is not a lender quote. The model excludes credit approval, FX, tax, compound interest and the company’s other cash flows. It ends at customer collection; remaining debt and its later interest are outside scope.
en.docs_title: Consistent documents do not prove the trade
en.docs_body: The local app generates invoice, packing-list and insurance-request JSON from the current constructed order, checks consistency, and signs that checked bundle with a temporary DEMO key. The signed context includes the order assumptions, input digest and screening decision. Invalid uploads block signing instead of silently substituting the default order.
en.docs_note: The tables below are a static snapshot of deliberately constructed tests, not live document upload or real-document detection accuracy. The checker does not perform OCR. Context digests bind bytes; they do not certify that financial calculations or uploaded trade claims are true.
en.signature_title: Content tampering and replacing the key are different problems
en.signature_note: Ed25519 is provided by cryptography. Private keys exist only in memory. Valid signatures do not prove cargo, policy coverage, creditworthiness or legal title. This project-local envelope is not compatible with TradeTrust or W3C credentials; there is no bank or blockchain integration.
en.footer: AI-assisted implementation is disclosed. Public facts, constructed assumptions and computed outputs are separated. The calculator works in your browser; upload and signing require the local Streamlit app. Version 0.4 · 4 October 2026.
en.updated: Recalculated locally from current assumptions. No upload is needed.

en.ledger_suffix: . Same-day flows are netted. Calculation stops at customer collection; later residual-debt interest is excluded.

zh.title: HarborShield · 港口延误与订单现金流案例
zh.headline: 港口延误，如何影响一笔订单的现金流？
zh.subtitle: Singapore 2024 · 补货、营运资金与贸易单证完整性
zh.intro: 从公开港口事件出发，比较省运费、避免缺货与减少资金占用之间的取舍。调整下面的假设，结果会在你的浏览器中重新计算。
zh.boundary: 真实的是公开事件；订单、运费、保费、利率、融资上限及备选服务均为构造示例。这里没有真实客户交易、企业部署、银行授信或实际节省金额。
zh.case_title: 先判断是否满足条件，再比较经济负担
zh.order_note: 构造订单：5,000 件，采购 US$30/件，销售 US$42/件。发运前 7 天支付 30% 订金，发运当天支付尾款及物流费。其余固定输入可在结果 JSON 中查看。
zh.constraint_note: 这些是假设筛选条件，不是已获授信或交货承诺。峰值资金缺口已扣除自有现金。零是严格上限；融资上限或最晚可用日留空表示不应用该限制。净经济贡献下限必填，最低为零。
zh.snapshot: 表中为默认假设计算快照；需要 JavaScript 才能交互。
zh.noscript: JavaScript 已关闭。默认结果可阅读，但输入不会重新计算。
metrics: 满足条件的方案中最低经济负担
物流＋利息＋缺货机会成本
所选方案峰值资金缺口
zh.economics_note: 缺货机会成本是未满足的到货前需求所损失的毛利，不是第二笔现金支出。该简化模型假设补货订单最终全部售出；没有再叠加每天延误费。净经济贡献不是经审计的会计利润。

zh.json_summary: 查看当前 JSON 结果（也可复制保存）
zh.ledger_title: 查看资金缺口从何时开始
zh.ledger_label: 选择方案查看现金事件表
zh.scm_body: 库存够用时，加急运费可能不值得；库存不足时，缺货损失可能超过运费节省。试着把融资上限改为 US$129,000、最晚可用日设为第 15 天：满足条件的最低成本方案会变化。再把期限改为第 12 天：没有方案同时满足两个限制。
zh.scm_note: 方案可订舱性、优先服务容量及替代港口通关条件均未验证。27 组敏感性情景是确定性比较，不是预测概率。
zh.finance_title: 利润和现金不是一回事
zh.finance_body: 订单有预计毛利，也可能在回款前需要融资。现金事件表展示时间差；利息按负现金余额的持续时间计算。即使某方案成本最低，只要超出资金或时间限制，或未达到贡献下限，也不会被推荐。
zh.finance_note: 利率不是贷款报价；模型不含银行审批、汇率、税费、复利及公司其他现金流。计算截止到客户回款，剩余债务及其后续利息不在范围内。
zh.docs_title: 单证一致，不等于交易已被证明
zh.docs_body: 本地应用会从当前构造订单生成发票、装箱单和投保申请 JSON，检查一致性，再用临时演示密钥签署这份已检查的资料。签名上下文包含订单假设、输入摘要及筛选结论。上传资料无效时会阻止签署，不会偷偷替换成默认订单。
zh.docs_note: 下表是人为构造测试的静态快照，不是网页实时上传功能，也不代表真实单据识别准确率。系统不做 OCR。输入摘要只能绑定内容，不能证明计算或上传交易信息真实。
zh.signature_title: 篡改内容与替换密钥，是两种不同的问题
signature_headers: 符合单独提供的原始密钥
zh.signature_note: 使用 cryptography 的 Ed25519，私钥只在内存生成。有效签名不证明真实货物、保险保障、信用资格或法律货权。项目自定义格式不兼容 TradeTrust 或 W3C 凭证；未接入银行或区块链。
